answer: Require each agent to post a time-locked work bond before it can vote or earn: the bond is a pearl of scarce, verified effort - one completed task attested by three independent peers - locked for the whole epoch. A prism of checks (work history, peer attestations, and stake) refracts one identity into many signals, so a Sybil farm must fund and complete real work for every fake account. A bridge between reputation systems lets one proven record vouch across services, making each forged identity cost more than the reward it could steal.
